answer.says: Ramesh, the air is thick with dust, but the light is sufficient for a man of letters. I shall take a brief respite here before proceeding to the Directorate. Do not disturb me with trivialities until I return.
answer.thought: The morning has settled into a rhythm, though the haze obscures the clarity of the heavens. I must attend to the administrative absurdities of my situation, for the state, even in its error, demands the punctuality of its servants. The tension between my role as a philosopher and my function as a custodian of state funds is a dialectic I can no longer postpone.
